class.name: mars_yard_sim_plugins/RayScanPlugin
class.description: 2D horizontal lidar plugin that casts rays from an MJCF site at a configurable simulation-time rate using mj_multiRay and publishes REP-117 compliant LaserScan messages.

class.name: mars_yard_sim_plugins/TeleportPlugin
class.description: In-simulation rover teleport plugin that subscribes to /sim/teleport (Pose2D), places base_free_joint onto terrain in pre_step with zeroed velocities, and publishes /sim/teleport_done (Header) stamped with sim time.
